mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.description: Load the uploaded government cloud migration RFP file (PDF/Word), parse its text, and convert it into a structured JSON representation that preserves sections, headings, tables, and key metadata. The output should include a list of all sections with their titles and raw content.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: JSON object containing the RFP’s hierarchical structure and raw text for each section.

units.description: From the structured RFP JSON, identify all mandatory technical compliance requirements (e.g., security controls, data residency, auditability). Produce a list of requirement identifiers, descriptions, and any associated scoring or weighting criteria.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: Array of objects each containing {requirement_id, description, weight/score}.

units.description: Using the extracted compliance list and typical cloud migration labor roles (e.g., Cloud Architect, Security Engineer, Project Manager), build a tiered pricing model. Include hourly rates for each role tier, estimated effort per requirement, and total cost per tier. Output should be a table in CSV/JSON format.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: Pricing table with columns: Role Tier, Hourly Rate, Estimated Hours per Requirement, Total Cost, Cumulative Cost.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Traceability Matrix
units.description: Compose a polished executive proposal that (1) summarizes the solution approach, (2) presents the multi‑tier labor pricing model, and (3) includes a traceability matrix linking each mandatory requirement to the specific solution activity and cost. The document should be formatted as a professional PDF/Word outline with headings, bullet points, and a final compliance summary.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t3]
units.output_contract: Final proposal document (PDF/Word) containing all sections and the traceability matrix.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal that satisfies the mandatory technical compliance criteria from an uploaded government cloud migration RFP, includes a multi‑tier labor pricing model, and provides a traceability matrix linking each requirement to the proposed solution.
dag.reasoning: The request requires four distinct phases: ingesting and structuring the RFP content, extracting the mandatory compliance items, building a detailed tiered labor cost model, and synthesizing an executive proposal with a traceability matrix. Each phase builds on the previous one, so dependencies are linear. All tasks involve read‑only data processing or generation, thus risk is low.
